result: In `scripts/player.gd` I added a "Reset Health" Inspector button using `@export_tool_button` (under a "Debug" group) that calls a new `reset_health()`, which sets `health` to `max_health` and emits `health_changed`. Tool buttons only work in `@tool` scripts, so I added `@tool` and an `Engine.is_editor_hint()` early return in `_physics_process`, so the player doesn't move in the editor. I haven't run any of this, since Godot isn't installed here.
